We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: High (高某) used a brick to hit 王某某's head, causing light injury (轻伤). This is an assault causing bodily injury. In Chinese criminal law, causing light injury by assault is "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). The fact that he used a brick, causing light injury, qualifies as intentional injury. Also there is prior criminal record but not relevant. So the charge: 故意伤害罪. Possibly also "聚众斗殴"? But only three persons, but the act is assault. The typical classification: "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). The injury is light, but still a crime. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>.
